notes: Medusa's effects in DSL v1 (docs/effects-dsl.md), written on 2026-10-28 from what the engine did wired by title. Since C5 (2026-10-29) the interpreter is what resolves these cards and the ability (docs/effects-dsl.md, section 15); the old code lives copied in tests/legacy_medusa.py as the oracle of tests/test_medusa_dsl_diff.py.
Every damage is effect damage: that is how the engine does it (game.damage defaults to 'effect'), including the 8 of Gaze of Stone and the 2 of A Momentary Glance; Planned Recklessness stops them.
Movements are 'up to N' with 0 included (the controller may return None in choose_move).
Ivan's decision (28/10): A Momentary Glance may target an own fighter.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Winged Frenzy: with several defeated Harpies, the owner (the bot) chooses which one returns.

ability.text: At the start of your turn, you may deal 1 damage to an opposing fighter in Medusa's zone.
ability.notes: Today it is run by Game.medusa_ability(target) with the target chosen by the controller (MedusaAI or the human); Medusa must be alive and the rival must share a zone with her.

cards.title: Second Shot
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: You may BOOST this attack.
cards.notes: Attack 3 / boost 3, Medusa only. The engine resolves it by title (combat.py SECOND_SHOT): the controller chooses the boost card in the DURING (choose_combat_boost). If the rival's IMMEDIATELY cancels it there is no boost.

cards.title: Gaze of Stone
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, deal 8 damage to the opposing fighter.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / boost 4, Medusa only. Effect damage (GAZE_DAMAGE): Planned Recklessness' shield stops it.

cards.title: Regroup
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card. If you won the combat, draw 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Dash
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Move your fighter up to 3 spaces.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 1, anyone. If the fighter died in the combat it does not move (alive selector by default).

cards.title: Feint
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 2, anyone. It does not cancel uncancelable cards (Liz's Incinerate).

cards.title: The Hounds of Mighty Zeus
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Move each Harpy up to 3 spaces.
cards.notes: Versatile 4 / boost 3, Harpy only. The engine moves the living Harpies one after another (HOUNDS_STEPS).

cards.title: Clutching Claws
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Your opponent discards 1 card.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 2, Harpy only. The rival chooses (Game.force_discard); live it stays as a pending discard until 'End action'.

cards.title: Hiss and Slither
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Your opponent discards 1 card.
cards.notes: Defense 4 / boost 3, Medusa only. Same as Clutching Claws.

cards.title: A Momentary Glance
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to any one fighter in Medusa's zone.
cards.notes: Scheme, boost 4, Medusa only. 'Any one fighter' includes your own: the engine (check_scheme) accepts any living fighter that shares a zone with Medusa, herself included. Effect damage (GLANCE_DAMAGE).

cards.title: Winged Frenzy
cards.text: Move each of your fighters up to 3 spaces. You may move them through spaces containing opposing fighters. Then, return a defeated Harpy (if any) to any space in Medusa's zone.
cards.notes: Scheme, boost 2, anyone. Movements go in fid order (Harpies and then Medusa, each seeing where the previous ones ended up); the first defeated Harpy returns with 1 life to a free space of Medusa's zone. Ivan's decision (28/10): the return is mandatory if there is room; a choose_placement that answers None leaves it on the first free space (the old engine left it defeated).

hidden_info.what: The rival discards a card of their choice.
hidden_info.bot: The bot does not look at the hand: it only sees the card that falls into the discard (public) and discounts it from KnownHand if it had seen it.

hidden_info.what: The boost card is discarded face up.

hidden_info.bot: It only changes the count of the rival's hand; nothing is inferred from the content.
